name: chat-about-learning-rust-yields-a-goal-draft
description: A chat about learning Rust ends with a drafted goal; nothing exists until the user approves the card.
messages: I want to learn Rust properly over the next few months, an hour on weekday evenings. Can you keep me on track?

arguments.title: Learn Rust
arguments.brief: Work through the Rust book at about an hour on weekday evenings. Success is finishing it and building one small command-line tool.

schedule.prompt: Give me tonight's Rust lesson and record my progress.

text: I proposed a goal with a weekday evening lesson. Approve it to create it.
